## Description

In an established uptrend, buys pullbacks toward a short/medium EMA after evidence of price resuming upward; reverses the logic for shorts.

## Where it may fit

Trending markets with shallow countertrend pullbacks rather than broad range-bound price action.

## Vehicles

Liquid stocks/ETFs, futures, FX, crypto.

## Required data

OHLCV bars, fast/slow EMAs, trend filter, volume/confirmation rule.

## Caveats

Subjective confirmation rules invite overfitting; fully specify entries, invalidation, stops and order timing.
